# Town of Windham municipal roster backfill -- Vermont
# municipal fan-out batch 27; issue #163 (VT master tracking).

sources.note: Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Vermont Selectboard Members' directory (updated June 5, 2026): refers Windham inquiries to the Town Clerk; no members are named
Town of Windham, 'Town Officials of Windham' (August 2025), the town's own officials form linked from its Town Directory: Selectboard -- Kord Scott (Chair), George Dutton, and Michael Pelton
17 V.S.A. section 2646: towns elect a town clerk

Town of Windham, Town Directory (live): Town Clerk Emily Shusdock. The August 2025 officials form and the Secretary of State's Guide name Bea Eliastam, who has since departed; the turnover mechanism is unpublished (flagged on issue #163)
17 V.S.A. section 2646: towns elect a town treasurer

Town of Windham, Town Directory (live): Town Treasurer Cathy Fales. The August 2025 officials form names Courtney Roth, who has since departed; the turnover mechanism is unpublished (flagged on issue #163)
17 V.S.A. section 2646: towns elect a board of listers
Town of Windham, Town Directory (live): Town Listers Bill Casey, Antje Ruppert, and Howie Ires

Town of Windham, 'Town Officials of Windham' (August 2025), the town's own officials form linked from its Town Directory: Antje Ruppert is the Board of Listers chair (the form's 'Rupert' spelling in the staff block yields to the directory's 'Ruppert')
17 V.S.A. section 2646: towns elect a board of auditors
Town of Windham, 'Town Officials of Windham' (August 2025), the town's own officials form linked from its Town Directory: Board of Auditors -- Kathy Jungermann, Becky Philips, and Pat McLaine

Town of Windham, 'Town Officials of Windham' (August 2025), the town's own officials form linked from its Town Directory: 'Road Commissioner: Kord Scott.' The office is not created by 17 V.S.A. section 2646 and no election for it is published, so the membership is modeled as appointed with the mechanism unpublished (flagged on issue #163)
17 V.S.A. section 2646 establishes the office (towns elect a moderator for a one-year term); no official source publishes the current holder, so the post is created without a membership
Town of Windham, Town Directory (live): no section of the directory or the officials form names a moderator, so the holder is unpublished

offices.org_name: Town of Windham Justices of the Peace

sources.note: Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Vermont Justices of the Peace' listing (updated December 4, 2025): lists five Windham justices of the peace: Marcia Clinton, Mary McCoy, Philip McDuffie, Alan McLaine, and Meredith Tips-McLaine

Town of Windham, Town Directory (live), Justices of the Peace: Mary McCoy, Marcia Clinton, Meredith Tips-McLaine, and Al McLaine -- four names; Philip McDuffie no longer appears and is treated as a departed winner (see the election note)

jp_election.name: Town of Windham Justice of the Peace Election 2024-11-05

sources.note: Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Vermont Justices of the Peace' listing (updated December 4, 2025): certifies the November 5, 2024 election of five justices of the peace for Windham: Marcia Clinton, Mary McCoy, Philip McDuffie, Alan McLaine, and Meredith Tips-McLaine. McDuffie is not carried as a winner: the town's live Town Directory lists only the other four as sitting justices, so he is treated as a departed winner and excluded entirely (the contest's vote_for remains five)
